Package org.thewhitemage13.interfaces

Interface OrderStatisticServiceInterface

All Known Implementing Classes:
OrderStatisticService
public interface OrderStatisticServiceInterface
Interface for managing OrderStatistic objects.

This interface defines the core operations for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting order statistics.

Version:
1.0.0
Author:
Mukhammed Lolo

  • Method Details

    • createOrderStatistic

      void createOrderStatistic(org.thewhitemage13.OrderCreatedEvent orderCreatedEvent)
      Creates a new order statistic based on the provided OrderCreatedEvent.

      This method is used to create an order statistic when a new order is placed.

      Parameters:
      orderCreatedEvent - the OrderCreatedEvent containing the details of the newly created order

    • updateOrderStatistic

      void updateOrderStatistic(org.thewhitemage13.OrderCreatedEvent orderCreatedEvent)
      Updates an existing order statistic based on the provided OrderCreatedEvent.

      This method is used to update an order statistic when an existing order is modified.

      Parameters:
      orderCreatedEvent - the OrderCreatedEvent containing the updated details of the order

    • deleteOrderStatisticByDate

      void deleteOrderStatisticByDate(LocalDate date)
      Deletes the order statistic for the specified date.

      This method is used to remove an order statistic based on its associated date.

      Parameters:
      date - the date of the OrderStatistic to be deleted

    • getOrderStatisticByDate

      OrderStatistic getOrderStatisticByDate(LocalDate date)
      Retrieves the order statistic for the specified date.

      This method fetches the order statistic associated with a particular date.

      Parameters:
      date - the date for which the order statistic is to be retrieved
      Returns:
      the OrderStatistic for the specified date

    • getAllOrderStatistics

      List<OrderStatistic> getAllOrderStatistics()
      Retrieves all order statistics.
